name: 07_noise_batch
description: Three independent low-signal alerts on three different resources - none share a resource_name, so none correlate with each other. Demonstrates that the incident list shows three distinct parked incidents rather than one merged incident, contrasting with scenarios 3-6 where same-resource signals fold together.
expected_outcome: all three score below 40 and land as separate parked incidents: 20 (anonymous actor +2), 36 (public-read anomaly +10, other actor +3), 36 (create action 1.1x, other actor +3).

signals.summary: Anonymous actor from 198.51.100.23 attempted SSH login to test VM — login failed, likely automated scanner or benign internet noise against non-production resource.
Terraform automation set staging API bucket to public-read — expected configuration for publicly accessible staging environment, no security concern.
QA automation service uploaded 200MB test fixture to QA cluster — routine test data setup, well below anomaly threshold for non-production environment.
